from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-7f8d820f.py')

code='''def transform(grid):
    # Fill each hollow rectangular frame. The fill color alternates with the
    # parity of the frame side length: even sides use 2, odd sides use 7.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color in (0, 6, 8, 9) or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            # Find connected component of this frame color.
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q = (y+dy, x+dx)
                    if 0 <= q[0] < h and 0 <= q[1] < w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            # A complete rectangle perimeter bounds the hollow area.
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                fill = 2 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
